probe.frame: cnc3018.glb model frame = frame of probe_arm's parent (cnc_z, identity at home): X = machine x - 150, Y = up (bed top 0), Z = machine y - 90, mm; node origin = pivot
probe.note: rotation = (clamp(deg, min, max) - modelled_deg) about axis through pivot; GLB modelled deployed (arm on its hard stop at stop_deg = modelled_deg); deployed_deg drives 3 deg past it
